design.validation_target: certified eventual vote shares and winners (terminal proxy)
design.training_rule: fit on cycles strictly before each holdout; 2018 poll error calibration only

wayback_poll_processing.availability_rule: created_at calendar date plus one full day

supplemental_senate_archive.availability_assumption: fieldwork end date plus seven days; publication date absent
supplemental_senate_archive.scope: two-party Senate questions only; independent-led and same-party ballots unsupported

reasons: Earlier-date election results are an imperfect proxy for a held-today nowcast.
Historical ballot rosters come from final results and may reveal later candidate entries or withdrawals at early cutoffs.
This replay covers the Stage 3/4 race-level core, not every 2026-only national, local, ballot, and joint-seat component.
Historical 538 CSVs were captured after the elections; their row creation dates are used, but retrospective source revisions cannot be fully ruled out.
Independent seat-distribution calibration and a geographic redistricting crosswalk are not yet evaluated; candidate-move evidence is only a partial diagnostic.
